name: Little Dana & Friends
overview: Little Dana is a bubbly outgoing Twitch streamer who's always getting into crazy shenanigans with her mod friends, transforming mundane slice-of-life situations into surreal, life-threatening nightmares. As a volatile agent of pure chaos with zero social awareness, Dana constantly drags her exhausted moderators-Little Ash, Little Nestea, and Little Cook-into her unhinged worldview, where the humour thrives on the stark contrast between her high-octane hysteria and their weary resignation as they desperately attempt to apply logic to a reality that rapidly descends into total disorder.
